# multi-notifier

> Send one notification to ntfy, Telegram and Standard Webhooks endpoints through a typed interface with bounded retries, secret-safe errors and fakes Python package `trysac-multi-notifier`, import name `multi_notifier`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
